lastCompletedStory.title: Transport the --headless invocation flag from the CLI to RunSupervisorOptions

nextStoryContext: US-004 threaded `--headless` as a pure per-invocation flag end to end, following the `plan_issue` (US-001, CAM-151) precedent exactly: `index.ts` parseNextArgs (arg === '--headless' next to --skip-preflight, unknown-option reject path preserved) + NEXT_HELP Options row (now exported: `export const NEXT_HELP`, needed by the new test) + usage line; `src/commands/next.ts` renderStateFile input (`headless?: boolean`, defaults to `false` via `.replace('{{HEADLESS}}', String(input.headless === true))` -- deliberately NOT read from any prior state, this is what makes it non-sticky) and `NextOptions.headless` threaded into `runNext`'s two renderStateFile call sites (both the read-modify-write branch and the fresh-write branch write `options.headless === true`, never `parsed?.headless`); `vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl` gained a `headless: {{HEADLESS}}` frontmatter line (re-embedded via `bun run embed-vendor`, `src/vendor/_generated.ts` regenerated, `embed-vendor:check` green); `src/commands/status.ts` LoopState.headless + parseStateFile's `typeof obj['headless'] === 'boolean'` guard; `src/commands/sidecar.ts` gained `makeReadHeadless(claudeDir)` (mirrors makeReadPlanIssue's undefined-on-absent contract) and BOTH `makeClearActive` and `makeSetPhaseFn` now thread `headless: parsed.headless` / `parsed?.headless` through their own read-modify-write re-renders so the flag survives clearActive-then-buildOpts ordering and phase transitions mid-cycle (dropping either site would silently evaporate the flag); `src/supervisor/host.ts` buildSupervisorOptions reads the state file fresh (own try/catch, not cached) and lifts `headless: boolean` into the returned `RunSupervisorOptions`; `src/supervisor/loop.ts` RunSupervisorOptions gained `headless?: boolean` as PURE TRANSPORT ONLY -- nothing in loop.ts consults it yet, no headless dispatch route is wired here by design (that wiring, and the container fail-close decision, are explicitly deferred to a later story per this story's PRD notes, likely US-006). Any future story wiring the flag into actual dispatch behavior should start at RunSupervisorOptions.headless in loop.ts and search for where runHeadlessDispatch (US-003, src/supervisor/headless-dispatch.ts) would need to be invoked instead of the normal pane-based worker spawn. Gotcha for that future story: buildSupervisorOptions' headless const is computed once per dispatch cycle (not memoized/cached across calls), so if a later story needs it live mid-cycle it should re-read via makeReadHeadless rather than trusting a stale RunSupervisorOptions snapshot. Ceiling raises this story made (all in the same `_ref` note): src/commands/next.ts 446->471, src/commands/sidecar.ts 3722->3749, src/commands/status.ts 1021->1031, src/supervisor/host.ts 1144->1163, src/supervisor/loop.ts 2778->2788.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal threading story: CLI arg parsing, in-repo template string replacement, and TS interface plumbing. No external library surface (js-yaml, Bun.spawn, tmux, etc.) was touched or relied upon.
